info.name: YouTube Soft Cream
info.description:
A soft, warm YouTube theme inspired by cozy journals, natural tones, and vintage stationery. It combines a creamy beige background with warm brown typography, soft neutral cards, subtle borders, rounded thumbnails, and a muted clay-red accent.
The theme also adds a gentle warm filter to video thumbnails, elegant serif titles, a customized playback bar in clay tones, and a softer, rounded playlist panel for a more cohesive and relaxing interface.
A simple, cozy aesthetic designed to make YouTube feel warmer, calmer, and a little more personal.
